rule_intent: SSH should use version 2 where supported

Derived from CIS Benchmark 1.1.2, NIST CM-7, and DISA STIG NET-0410

rule_intent: Unencrypted management HTTP should be disabled where HTTPS is available
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark 1.1.3, NIST SC-8, and DISA STIG NET-0420

rule_intent: Centralized AAA should be enabled where applicable
provenance: Derived from NIST IA-2, CIS Benchmark 1.1.4, and DISA STIG NET-0500

rule_intent: Security-relevant logging should be forwarded to a remote collector where required
provenance: Derived from NIST AU-12, CIS Benchmark 1.1.5, and DISA STIG NET-0600

rule_intent: SNMPv1 should be disabled where secure alternatives are available
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark 1.1.6, NIST CM-7, and DISA STIG NET-0700

rule_intent: NTP time synchronization should be enabled to authoritative time sources
provenance: Derived from NIST AU-8 and DISA STIG NET-0800

rule_intent: Authorized access advisory banner must be presented before interactive login
provenance: Derived from NIST AC-8 and DISA STIG NET-0900

rule_intent: HTTPS must be enabled when web management interface is present
provenance: Derived from NIST SC-8 and ISO 27001 A.8.24

rule_intent: Password minimum length must be at least 14 characters
